lines.text: Hat? Pipe. Fell asleep. Don't tell anybody.
Do you know Abigail Ness? The fiddler? Her niece, I mean. Lydia. Not her. Well. Her niece.
I wrote it down so I'd say it right. Now I can't say it at all. If somebody was to carry it to Mrs. Ness, she could pass it along. Somebody who wouldn't read it.
Give it here, Caleb. I've carried worse, and read none of it.
The paper has been folded and unfolded so many times it has gone soft as cloth.

banner: From Caleb Stroud. Not to be read

lines.text: Mrs. Ness is on the Green. You didn't read it? You look like you read it.
From Caleb Stroud. For Lydia, by way of you.
That long boy with the hole in his hat? He's been walking past my house since haying. I thought he was simple.
She reads the note, without any shame, and tucks it into her shawl.
She'll have it by supper. Tell him she says he's spelled "Thursday" wrong. And tell him she says yes.
Lydia Ness says you've spelled "Thursday" wrong.
Oh. Oh! Yes to what? No. Don't tell me. I know what I wrote. Do I? Here, take this cider. I can't drink anything just now.
I've got to dance now. I never thought about that part.
